scope: Prevent the canonical story worker from finalizing a nonpartial candidate with blocking QC findings; retain the report and checkpoint for repair.

source.note: The service/test files also contain the previously assigned SPEC161 outcome/owner repair; the hashes identify their complete current contents, not only the additive QC delta.

repair.behavior: After storing the QC report, the worker transitions a nonpartial run to needs_repair and returns STORY_GENERATION_BLOCKING_FINDINGS when any report finding is blocking or finalGateEligible is false. It does not invoke finalization. A report with no blocking findings and finalGateEligible true continues through existing finalization.
repair.durability: The validation report and current checkpoint are persisted before the needs_repair transition; the canonical worker outcome becomes failed with the specific QC reason retained in its projection.

verification.runtime: Owner-marked private PostgreSQL loopback/Unix-socket fixture; actual Drizzle assurance repository, canonical worker control plane, and runtime_ephemeral_values. Fixture table columns/defaults/indexes derive from canonical verticalDramaStoryGenerationRuns Drizzle metadata; cross-domain foreign keys are intentionally omitted. The story executor is deterministic at the existing router boundary; no SQL is mocked and no provider is called.

limits: The current validator emits blocking findings or an empty eligible report; it does not presently generate an advisory-only finding. The worker gate tests both blocker rejection and eligible finalization, and its predicate permits nonblocking findings when finalGateEligible remains true.
This is bounded native worker/QC evidence, not full SPEC161 acceptance. No migrations, production runtime, paid provider, full typecheck/build, or retired systems were used.

Best-effort system-failure reporting during the expected QC rejection logs missing feedback_tickets/users.email in the intentionally minimal fixture; these reports are swallowed and the worker/QC assertions pass.
